title: 第21章 你们都欺负老实人是吧第22章 我倒要看看谁敢动我儿
content_zh:
许小凡直接来到了举行寿宴的宫殿附近。
这地方此刻人很多。
但没办法，他可不想再遇到刚刚那种事。
其实他此刻心中还是有几分忐忑。
他杀的人肯定有背景，有背景就会被调查，一但调查起来...
许小凡脑海中浮现出了那个叫端木柔的美貌女子。
接着摇摇头。
对方估摸着也不会暴露他。
毕竟是自己救了她。
救命之恩就算不以身相许，那最起码得给自己保密不是？
这么想着，许小凡很快便遇见了熟人。
当然，以这种方式相遇，许小凡感觉有点尴尬。
只见在宫殿的角落处，一个胖子正在被一群差不多年纪的世家子殴打。
此刻的许小凡其实有点庆幸。
幸好之前没答应跟这家伙混，否则这份打估摸着也有自己一份...
犹豫片刻，在不影响系统任务的情况下，许小凡还是决定出手帮一帮。
毕竟也是过命的交情！
想到这，许小凡直接走了上去，大声道：
“各位大哥，别冲动！”
几个衣着华贵的少年看了过来。

被殴打的胖子也看了过来，一时间泪流满面！
一个少年疑惑道：“你他娘是谁呀？”
许小凡一指张化龙，说道：“我是他朋友，可能给个面子？”
给面子？
几个少年表情玩味起来，一人问：“你是哪家的？”
许小凡拱手道：“许家。”
少年们面面相觑，“许家你们听过吗？”
众人摇头。
一人讥讽道：“许家算个什么东西？要本少爷给面子？”
许小凡认真道：“我们许家刚刚来帝都不久。”
众人闻言，皆捧腹大笑。
唯有张化龙，看着这些人，不由怜悯起来。
许家！
别人不知道他还能不知道吗！
这年头，谁得罪许家，谁倒霉！
许家父子，可都是狠人啊！
这个时候，几个世家子笑罢，直接朝着许小凡冲了过去！
content_en:
Xu Xiaofan went directly to the palace where the birthday banquet was held.
There are a lot of people in this place at the moment.
But there was no way, he didn't want to encounter the same thing just now.
In fact, he still felt a little uneasy at the moment.
The person he killed must have a background. If there is a background, he will be investigated. Once investigated...
The beautiful woman named Duan Murou appeared in Xu Xiaofan's mind.
Then he shook his head.
The other party probably wouldn't expose him.
After all, he saved her.
Even if you don’t pledge yourself to save your life, then at least you have to keep it a secret, right?
Thinking like this, Xu Xiaofan soon met an acquaintance.
Of course, Xu Xiaofan felt a little embarrassed when they met in this way.
In the corner of the palace, a fat man was being beaten by a group of aristocratic men of similar age.
Xu Xiaofan was actually a little lucky at this moment.
Fortunately, I didn't agree to hang out with this guy before, otherwise I would have had a share in this estimate...
After hesitating for a moment, Xu Xiaofan decided to help out without affecting the system tasks.
After all, it is a life-long friendship!
Thinking of this, Xu Xiaofan walked up directly and said loudly:
"Brothers, don't be impulsive!"
Several richly dressed teenagers looked over.
The beaten fat man also looked over and burst into tears for a moment!
A young man asked in confusion: "Who the hell are you?"
Xu Xiaofan pointed at Zhang Hualong and said, "I am his friend, maybe I can give him some face?"
Give face?
Several teenagers looked amused, and one of them asked: "Which family are you from?"
Xu Xiaofan cupped his hands and said, "Xu family."
The teenagers looked at each other, "Have you heard of the Xu family?"
Everyone shook their heads.
One person sarcastically said: "Who do the Xu family count? Do you want me to give you face?"
Xu Xiaofan said seriously: "Our Xu family has just arrived in the imperial capital not long ago."
When everyone heard this, they all laughed.
Only Zhang Hualong couldn't help but feel pity when he looked at these people.
Xu family!
How can he not know if others don't know?
These days, whoever offends the Xu family will be in trouble!
The Xu family father and son are both ruthless people!
At this time, several members of the aristocratic family stopped laughing and rushed towards Xu Xiaofan!
